controller.title: Controller relays
controller.description:
Controller type: {controller_type}

Relay 1: delay {delay_1} s
Relay 2: delay {delay_2} s
Relay 3: delay {delay_3} s

A delay of 0 s means the relay latches until switched off; otherwise it switches off by itself after the delay. Delays are set in the intercom's web interface.

Choose which relays to add to Home Assistant. You can change this later with Configure.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The intercom rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current ones.

abort.wrong_device: A different intercom answers at this address.

init.title: Controller relays
init.description:
Controller type: {controller_type}

Relay 1: delay {delay_1} s
Relay 2: delay {delay_2} s
Relay 3: delay {delay_3} s

A delay of 0 s means the relay latches until switched off; otherwise it switches off by itself after the delay. Delays are set in the intercom's web interface.

Choose which relays to add to Home Assistant.

**Call button:** in the intercom's web interface, open Network settings → HTTP event, enable it and set Protocol **{ha_protocol}**, Host name **{ha_host}**, Request **{webhook_path}**, Method **GET**, authentication off. Then in Alarm settings → Call button, tick HTTP event and enter **{call_parameter}**. Keep the request path private.

abort.not_loaded: The intercom is not loaded. Make sure it is reachable and try again.

Then in Alarm settings → Call button, tick HTTP event and enter **{call_parameter}**. Keep the request path private.

motion_detection_off.title: Motion detection is off on {name}
motion_detection_off.description: Motion detection is turned off in the intercom's web interface, so the Motion sensor will never turn on. Turn it on in Alarm settings → Motion detection, then reload the integration. If you don't need motion, disable the Motion sensor instead; this warning then goes away.
